The '''2024 Retro League Event 4''' was the fourth event of the [[2024 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]], played in [[Premiere - Death Star II]] format. It ran from 25 August to 2 October 2024.<ref name="t84006" /> [[Joe Horbey]] won.<ref name="t83974" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 25 August – 2 October 2024
* '''Players:''' 73 (72 with derived places)
* '''Winner:''' [[Joe Horbey]]

== Final standings ==
No event standings were posted for Event 4.<ref name="t84006" /> '''Places derived from the change in cumulative league points between the after-Event 3 and after-Event 4 standings.'''<ref name="p1428054" /><ref name="p1430268" /> League points are 3 per win and 1 per loss, plus 4 bonus points for first place and 2 for second.<ref name="t84316" /> The bonuses separate [[Joe Horbey]] (winner) from [[Paul Todd Feldman]] (runner-up); other players with equal points share a place. The cumulative standings do not include strength of schedule, so these places may differ from the tournament software's ranking. [[Kevin Bing]], [[Jason Ayre]], [[David Garcia]] and [[Jonathan Grubb]] are not in the after-Event 3 list and are counted from zero. [[Paul Bellitto]]'s after-Event 3 total is cut off in the posted image, so 12 points (his 3–3 record in Event 3) is assumed.<ref name="p1428053" /> [[Chris Webb]] was paired in Week 1 only and gained no points, so he has no place.<ref name="t84006" /> GEMP handles are from the organizer's participant lists and players' pages.<ref name="org2022" /><ref name="org2026" /><ref name="retro-gempc-86781" /><ref name="roster" /><ref name="slack-kb" />
